title: vacancy_short_code helper duplicates gdpr_integration_test's fetch_vacancy_short_code (same directory, same query)
detail: Third copy of the same short_code-by-id lookup in the same test directory (application_integration_test.gleam:1727 inlines it too). AGENTS.md DRY rule: extract a shared helper into integration/helpers.gleam.
recommended_fix: Move one short-code lookup into integration/helpers.gleam (pub fn) and call it from draft_integration_test and gdpr_integration_test.

title: Round-2 W7 test adds one-line alias wrappers form_view_now_ms / near_future_date instead of calling the real functions directly
detail: Pure pass-through aliases used once each. The established convention in the same directory calls the wrapped functions directly (application_integration_test.gleam:1812 `form_view.current_unix_ms() - 5000`, :1820 `test_helpers.near_future_iso_date()`).
recommended_fix: Delete both wrappers; call form_view.current_unix_ms() and test_helpers.near_future_iso_date() inline like the other integration tests.

title: resume_on_closed_vacancy_renders_closed_page_test never asserts the closed page — only the absence of resume markers
evidence:
resp.status |> should.equal(200)
  let body = simulate.read_body(resp)
  body
  |> string.contains("data-apply-page=\"form-resume\"")
  |> should.be_false
  body |> string.contains("draft-resume-banner") |> should.be_false
--- positive marker exists at server/src/application/form_pages.gleam:31 ---
            attribute("data-testid", "closed-vacancy-notice"),
detail: The test name claims the closed page renders, but the assertions also pass on the friendly 404 page or any non-resume 200 body. view_closed_vacancy_page ships a unique data-testid="closed-vacancy-notice" that is left unasserted.
recommended_fix: Add `body |> string.contains("closed-vacancy-notice") |> should.be_true` so the pin fails if the branch renders anything but the closed page.
